validation_policy: Existing core constraints are unchanged. New property registrations are descriptive. Vocabulary checks are explicit opt-in checks, not core conformance requirements.

properties.label: alternative
properties.definition: An alternative name for the dataset.
properties.usage: This property contains an alternative name for the Dataset. This property can be repeated for parallel language versions of the alternative name.

properties.label: anatomical location covered
properties.definition: Relates a dataset to an anatomical class that is Anatomical structure (SNOMED CT 91723000) or one of its subclasses, describing anatomical coverage of the dataset as a whole at metadata or catalogue level.
properties.usage: Use a SNOMED CT anatomical class: Anatomical structure (91723000) or a direct or indirect subclass. No skos:Concept typing is required. This describes dataset-level coverage and does not associate a location with a particular modality, data category, sample, or record. The OWL Full range entails subclass membership; it does not validate SNOMED classification. Use separately trusted hierarchy evidence for the opt-in validation checks.

properties.label: health condition of interest
properties.definition: Relates a dataset to a SNOMED CT or ICD-10 concept representing a disease, disorder, or other clinical condition that the dataset concerns as a whole.
properties.usage: Use a SNOMED CT or ICD-10 concept for a disease, disorder, or other clinical condition concerning the dataset as a whole. Type the value as skos:Concept. This does not assert a diagnosis for any participant. Identifier-format checks do not establish concept existence, activity, or clinical suitability.

properties.label: landing page
properties.definition: A web page that provides access to the Dataset, its Distributions and/or additional information.
properties.usage: It is intended to point to a landing page at the original data provider, not to a page on a site of a third party, such as an aggregator.

properties.label: provenance
properties.definition: A statement about the lineage of a Dataset.
properties.usage: Information about how the data was collected, including methodologies, tools, and protocols used, this property can be repeated for different versions of the provenance (e.g. the provenance in different languages).
